answer.worked: H: it has no $x$-intercepts, so $\Delta<0$, and it opens upwards, so $a>0$.
B, C, G, H and I: each has axis of symmetry $x=1$. Since the axis is $x=-\dfrac{b}{2a}$, each satisfies $-\dfrac{b}{2a}=1$.
I: its $y$-intercept is $-8$. Substituting $x=0$ into $y=ax^{2}+bx+c$ gives $y=c$, so $c=-8$.
G: it passes through $(0,8)$ and has axis of symmetry $x=1$. Reflecting $(0,8)$ across this axis gives $(2,8)$.
F: it is tangent to the $x$-axis, giving one repeated real root. Therefore $\Delta=0$.
D: its $x$-intercepts are $-2$ and $3$, so $y=(x+2)(x-3)$. Thus $\alpha+\beta=-2+3=1$, which is odd.
